unit: luma 0-255 (mean of footage region x0-1540 y0-400)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: full-frame footage darkens to about 27% of its brightness while a 1-line caption snaps on (hard on, full white in the picture f4420, no fade); the footage keeps its slow camera pull-back, and its own luma drifts slowly before (112 -> 107 over f4397-f4412) and after (28.4 -> 24.8 over f4430-f4450). Whether the darkening is a designed scrim or the footage's own lighting change cannot be separated (it is uniform: lower region 121 -> 34 at the same time)
